sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned HCGP for respondent No.1.
Respondent No.2, who is served in the matter, has remained unrepresented before this Court.

NC: 2024:KHC:51157 3. FIR in Crime No.135/2024 was registered by Bommanahalli Police Station, Bengaluru City against Ravikumar and petitioner herein for the aforesaid offences, on the basis of the first information dated 09.04.2024 received from respondent No.2, who is the mother of the victim girl aged about 7 years.
4. During the course of investigation of the case, the petitioner herein was arrested on 15.04.2024 and subsequently remanded to judicial custody.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed for the aforesaid offences against two persons.
Petitioner is arrayed as accused No.2 in the charge sheet.
Bail application filed by the petitioner before the Trial Court in Crl.Misc.No.4253/2024 was rejected on 10.06.2024.
Therefore, he is before this Court.
5. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is a youngster aged about 21 years having no criminal antecedents.
Before the Trial Court, the first informant and the victim girl have been examined as NC: 2024:KHC:51157 P.W-1 and P.W-2.
Therefore, there cannot be any apprehension that the petitioner is likely to tamper with the material prosecution witnesses in the Sandeep.

K vs State Of Karnataka on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149462396/
2
present case.
Accordingly, he prays to allow this petition.
6. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.

7. Perusal of the material on record would go to show that FIR in Crime No.135/2024 was registered by Bommanahalli Police Station against Ravikumar and the petitioner herein on the basis of the first information submitted by respondent No.2, who is the mother of the victim girl.
8. Accused Nos.1 & 2 are the close relatives of the first informant.
Petitioner aged about 21 years having no criminal antecedents is in custody from 15.04.2024.
Investigation of the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.

Statement of the victim girl under Section 164 of Cr.P.C was recorded before the Jurisdictional NC: 2024:KHC:51157 Magistrate and the victim girl has stated that she had made the said statement as per the instruction of her mother.

Before the Trial Court,
the first informant is examined P.W-1 and the victim girl is examined as P.W-2.
Since the material charge sheet witnesses have been already examined before the Trial Court, there cannot be any apprehension that the petitioner is likely to tamper with the prosecution witnesses.

9. Learned Counsel for the petitioner has brought to the notice of this Court even during the course of deposition, the victim girl has reiterated the statement made by her under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.
Prosecution in all has cited 32 charge sheet witnesses in the present case.
Till date only two witnesses have been examined before the Trial Court as P.W-1 and P.W-2.
Therefore, the chances of trial being completed in the near future is very remote.
Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that the prayer made by the petitioner for grant of regular bail NC: 2024:KHC:51157 needs to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, the following:-
ORDER
The petition is allowed.

The petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail in Spl.C.No.946/2024 pending before the Court of Additional City Civil and Sessions Judge, FTSC-III Bengaluru,
arising out of Crime No.135/2024 registered by Bommanahalli Police Station,
Bengaluru City for the offences punishable under Sections 376AB, 376(2)(f),
376(2)(l), 506 of IPC and Sections 3(a), 4(2), 5(m), 5(n), 11(i), 12, 16 and 17 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offenses Act 2012,, subject to the following conditions:
a) The petitioner shall execute personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) with two sureties for the likesum, to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court;
b) The petitioner shall appear regularly on all the dates of hearing before the Trial NC: 2024:KHC:51157 Court unless the Trial Court exempts his appearance for valid reasons;
